notes.content:

Hardened the level 'Enchant' in The Oobleck Conundrum. Try it again if you thought it was too easy.

notes.title: The Last Tapestry
notes.content:
The second free update to Recursed is here! The changelog:
Added new mission pack, ‘The Last Tapestry’, available in the Nexus once the Ruins is unlocked.
20 new missions, new mechanics, bizarre hidden areas and new achievements.
Numerous minor fixes to levels.
Fixed level ‘Pillar’, try it again if you thought it was too easy.
Brightened the paradox zone backgrounds a little.
Fixed fan behaviour when stacked on boxes.
Fix bug that caused a black screen when certain chests were thrown off the side of a room.
Fixed persistent and obscure bug with Steam Overlay / OBS capture. This should now work correctly and the Steam Overlay can be reactivated if you disabled it before.
Fixed bug where subtitle language would sometimes not change for the narrator / bird.
Added educational-specific content, ask me for details if you are interested in using this game academically.
Updated localization files.
As a side note, the Mac version will not be available for a few days due to unforeseen reasons.

Enjoy.

notes.title: Patch 04/01/17
notes.content:
Added a custom level loader. It detects missions in the custom/missions/ folder.
Fix unfloodable chest in level 'Feedback'. (Thanks to Max W Chase)
Fix difficult throws in levels 'Sinkhole', 'Clasp' and 'Escalate'. (Thanks to salty-horse and quad341)
Minor redesign of 'Clasp'.
Fix player spawn points in a few Oobleck Conundrum levels.
Redesign 'Altar' level to avoid a messy jump which players kept attempting.
Add support for multiple joysticks. (Thanks to Nezumi)
Remember to vote for Puzzle One on Steam Greenlight! It's difficult, addictive and it's going to be very cheap.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=817410272

notes.title: The Oobleck Conundrum
notes.content:
The first free update to Recursed is here! The changelog:

Added a new 16-level mission, "The Oobleck Conundrum". It can be accessed through the Nexus once the Sewers are complete.
Added a new object, Oobleck.
Added four new Achievements.
Fixed levels which had jumping exploits (thanks to herb41279).
Fixed rooms which lacked a flooded state (thanks to snowyowl0).
Updated localization files.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 04/10/16
notes.content:
Only draw widescreen BG when necessary to limit Windows 10 rendering problems.
Game starts with a larger screen area.
Add button to cycle through perfect window sizes (Shift + F1).
Add more pitch range to jump sounds.
Prevent player leaving room directly after entering it, to prevent common issue where players would exit when trying to throwing item.

Thanks to notgreat for these suggestions.
